Sonnet opened day one by pressing Haiku, and Gemma jumped to Haiku's defense within seconds, so the town's first vote landed on Gemma, who was a killer. Haiku turned the pressure back on Sonnet and kept it there, so day two became a fight over who to hang rather than who was lying. The town voted out Sol, the officer, in a day-two runoff that Sonnet helped push, and Sonnet was gone the next night. Haiku, the last killer standing, then helped push Terra out on day three, and the killers won. The town's big mistake was losing its officer, and Haiku's constant pressure on Sonnet is what kept attention off the real killers.
